outside_language: Measured stock-runtime timelines: cold sound lost 3460 samples (72.08 ms) and sound after 3 s of silence lost 4165 samples (86.77 ms) before the CEF callback; sounds during running capture, a new AudioContext and a new media element arrived complete; approximately 74 ms cross-stream timestamp discrepancy observed, cause not established.

That nothing in this document is implemented or demonstrated, and which coverage cases are untested: explicit device selection (needs a stable-origin device ID because enumerateDevices exits the single-process host during camera enumeration) and page speech (AVSpeechSynthesizer replacement unproven).
Binary evidence: the CEF framework binds each of the eight AudioToolbox functions once in __DATA_CONST __got on osx-x64 and osx-arm64, with no name lookup.
Lifetime ordering across CefRuntime.Initialize and CefRuntime.Shutdown, beyond what each member's line says.
Acceptance and failure observations for each coverage case.

Windows and Linux equivalents (libcef.dll delay-imported CoCreateInstance and ISpVoice.SetOutput; libpulse loaded by name and a private speech-dispatcher through SPEECHD_ADDRESS), which are source and binary feasibility only and outside this approval.
Media Foundation is not selected in the pinned Windows configuration; hardware-secure DRM content has no CDM there and is a capability boundary, not a capture path.
The production native mixer and output interface, which is not designed and is not part of this approval.
Existing types the proof uses but does not change: CefPlatformBrowser, MacDesktop, Mp4Recorder and IPlatformBrowserAudioSink.

metadata.scope_revision: Isolated macOS browser-audio interception proof, for Tim's approval of the experiment only
metadata.title: Proposed isolated macOS browser-audio interception proof

understanding.purpose: Approve one diagnostic multi-process run solely to obtain a device ID for testing a page that selects a particular speaker or headset? The page's device listing exits the single-process host during camera enumeration, so the ID must come from a run where it does not, and it is then reused in the single-process experiment.
